data.gender_notes: Abaid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted and obedient to Allah. Derived from the Arabic root word 'Abd' which means 'servant'. The name Abaid carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abaid usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abaid total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_urdu.name: عبید
